stages.name: TRUST THE DATA
stages.goal: Prove data integrity before advanced learning.

stages.name: PROTECT CAPITAL
stages.goal: Stops and capital protection are reliable.

stages.name: READ DIRECTION
stages.goal: Beat random directional behaviour out of sample.

stages.name: REVERSAL / RE-ENTRY
stages.goal: Recognise failed thesis, reverse opportunities and re-entry.

stages.name: CONTEXT INTELLIGENCE
stages.goal: Breadth, rotation, external events and historical analogues.

stages.name: CAPITAL ALLOCATION
stages.goal: Only after prior competencies are reliable.

rule: Advanced autonomy stays locked until earlier competencies have measurable evidence.
